# Bodies of several assignments stay scalar when the vector loop would not
# match the scalar order or one vector type cannot hold every store: the range
# value variable after a store to the ranged slice, stores of different element
# types, a self copy, and more slices than the overlap checks are budgeted for.

cp ops.go ops.go.orig
loopvec -split .
! stdout .
! stderr .
! exists ops_simd.go
cmp ops.go ops.go.orig

loopvec -json .
cmpenv stdout stdout.want

-- go.mod --
module example.com/test

go 1.27.1
-- ops.go --
package test

// v is the element before the store to a[i], which a reload would not see.
func RangeValueAfterStore(a, b []int32) {
	for i, v := range a {
		a[i] = 1
		b[i] = v
	}
}

func MixedTypes(a []int32, b []float32) {
	for i := range a {
		a[i] = 1
		b[i] = 2
	}
}

func SelfCopy(a, b, c []float32) {
	for i := range a {
		a[i] = a[i]
		b[i] = c[i]
	}
}

func TooManySlices(a, b, c, d, e, f, g, h, k []float32) {
	for i := range a {
		a[i] = b[i] + c[i]
		d[i] = e[i] + f[i]
		g[i] = h[i] + k[i]
	}
}
